sourceTypeExtension.rule: Every admitted SensorKit output states the exact sourceTypeCode from its one catalog entry.

statusDefinitions.supported: Version 0.6.0 defines a lossless structured mapping to the listed source-neutral Sensor profile plus the SensorKit adapter profile. A row may require the listed linked native Recording Document when exact source fields cannot be carried in the structured projection alone.
statusDefinitions.mapped-standard: Version 0.6.0 admits the stream as the listed source-neutral Sensor Recording Document and does not invent a structured scalar or waveform meaning.
statusDefinitions.platform-exclusive: Version 0.6.0 defines the listed platform-exclusive SensorKit structured profile because no exact source-neutral or international profile exists.
statusDefinitions.unmodeled: The platform stream is inventoried, but no shared or SensorKit-scoped profile models it and no output is admitted.
statusDefinitions.deferred: The platform stream is inventoried, but version 0.6.0 publishes no admitted output contract.
statusDefinitions.intentionally-unsupported: Version 0.6.0 deliberately refuses the stream because any available representation would create a misleading or unsafe meaning.

observationIssued.rule: SensorKit supplies measurement times but no distinct current-result availability instant. Omit Observation.issued; conversion, fetch, assembly, and upload times must not be substituted.

sourceEvidence.scope: The exact 22 public Apple SRSensor symbols frozen by the version 0.6.0 catalog.

inventoryScopes.catalog-baseline: One of the 20 platform symbols in the initial closed catalog baseline.
inventoryScopes.stable-addition: A stable platform symbol added to complete the stated SDK baseline.

sharedObservation.rule: exactly two direct meta.profile claims: the listed source-neutral Sensor semantic profile and the SensorKit adapter profile

hybridObservation.rule: exactly two direct meta.profile claims: the listed source-neutral Sensor semantic profile and the exact SensorKit hybrid adapter child; one linked exact native Recording Document is mandatory

recordingDocument.rule: exactly two direct meta.profile claims: the source-neutral Sensor Recording Document profile and the SensorKit Recording Document adapter profile
recordingDocument.defaultRule: Every admitted raw representation uses this profile pair and output discriminator unless its row explicitly replaces them.

providerSpecificObservation.rule: exactly one direct meta.profile claim: the listed SensorKit-only profile, which inherits the adapter envelope

conversionProvenance.rule: The adapter-specific Provenance targets every structured and raw output from the source record and carries that exact source-record Identifier as its sole source entity.

quantityValueDomains.rule: Every Quantity in the listed SensorKit-only summary profiles is a source-domain non-negative value. A component Quantity coded as UCUM {count} in the listed count profiles is additionally an integer; no physiologic upper range is invented.

rawPayloadAdmission.failureRule: The producer fails closed before emission unless the caller supplies exactly one assertion.

sourceRecord.nativeRecordRule: SensorKit does not expose a durable sample identifier. The producer atomically assigns and persists an opaque acquisition-record key while staging each source record, before FHIR conversion. Exact delivery retries reuse the staged key; every distinct callback record receives a distinct key even when its bytes and measured values are equal. Measured values, serialized payload digests, subject references, Resource.id, and processing times are prohibited key-selection inputs.

acquisitionCoordinate.stream: Partition the durable acquisition ledger by repository scope, exact SRSensor token, and a producer-stable opaque source-stream partition. SRDevice.productType is descriptive partition evidence, not by itself physical-unit identity.
acquisitionCoordinate.resetGeneration: Persist a non-negative reset generation per stream. Increment it only for an explicit source-cursor reset after the prior generation has no unresolved pending delivery; retries, callback rebatching, process restarts, and ordinary cursor advancement never increment it.
acquisitionCoordinate.record: At first staging, assign the next monotonic delivery ordinal within the reset generation to every delivered source record in its preserved source order. The durable acquisition coordinate is [reset-generation, delivery-ordinal]. A source time or interval is verification evidence only; no occurrence counter resets at a callback boundary.
acquisitionCoordinate.pendingBatch: Before yielding any converted record, atomically persist the reset generation, pending start ordinal, exact pending record count, each ordered opaque acquisition key, source verification coordinates/bytes, and the pre-yield cursor boundary. Cursor advancement commits only after every pending record is durably handed off.
acquisitionCoordinate.ordering: Preserve source delivery order across callback batches. Never sort by measured values or timestamps, use a Set or map iteration order, reset an equal-coordinate occurrence per callback, or collapse byte-equal records; duplicate multiplicity is part of the acquired source stream.
acquisitionCoordinate.retry: After a crash or retry, reconcile deliveries in order against the durable pending batch and reuse its acquisition keys and delivery ordinals even if the platform splits or combines callback batches differently. Only deliveries beyond the resolved pending boundary receive new ordinals.
acquisitionCoordinate.conflict: A payload digest may verify staged bytes but never selects identity. If retry evidence cannot reconcile exactly to the durable pending sequence and the source exposes no revision semantics, fail closed as an acquisition conflict instead of minting a content-derived identity.

vectors.assertion: Equal timestamps delivered in different callbacks remain two distinct acquisition records; callback-local occurrence zero must not collide.
A two-record pending delivery retried as two callbacks reuses both persisted coordinates and does not mint ordinals 122 or 123.

sourceOutput.outputRoleRule: Use structured or native-recording according to the selected catalog representation.
sourceOutput.outputDiscriminatorRule: Use the exact outputDiscriminator on the admitted structured or raw representation. The HMAC length framing accepts arbitrary Unicode without a separator grammar; there is no fallback.

sourceArtifact.rule: A raw recording uses its registered format code and zero-based part index in addition to the source-record coordinates.

identity.resourceIdPolicy: Resource.id is optional and repository-assigned. SensorKit business identifiers are never copied into Resource.id.

entries.title: Acoustic settings
entries.reason: Version 0.6.0 publishes no reviewed output contract for this stable platform symbol.

structured.reason: The source contains heterogeneous light fields for which version 0.6.0 does not publish a lossless component profile.
Pressure and temperature are mixed-unit fields and must not be collapsed into one SampledData value.

graphContract.relationship: The summary Observation.derivedFrom contains exactly one internal UUID reference to the native Recording Document in the same Grove Mobile collection Bundle.

nativeR4Mappings.rule: Emit exactly one SensorKitValueCS coding, guided or unguided. Per-voltage flags and native session state remain in the required Recording Document.

structured.admissionRule: All batches form one complete uniform series at the exact reported frequency, one exact lead orientation is retained, and no voltage sample is omitted. Non-uniform, incomplete, mixed-lead, or inconsistent input fails closed.

graphContract.relationship: The ECG Observation.derivedFrom contains exactly one internal UUID reference to the native Recording Document in the same Grove Mobile collection Bundle.

structured.reason: Version 0.6.0 publishes no reviewed structured profile for the heterogeneous face metrics.

fields.name: version

fields.name: context

fields.name: partialFaceExpressions

fields.name: wholeFaceExpressions
fields.meaning: [{identifier: string, value: number}] from [SRFaceMetricsExpression].

jsonSchema.structure: UTF-8; one JSON array of per-keyboard report objects in source order; every declared field present; a distribution with no samples encodes an empty values array; timestamps are seconds since the Unix epoch.
jsonSchema.fields: Designer 1's field list adopted verbatim: timestamp, duration, keyboardIdentifier, version, width (mm), height (mm), inputModes, sessionIdentifiers, counts object with exactly the 19 Int properties, totalPathTime (s), totalPathLength (mm), totalTypingDuration (s), typingSpeed, pathTypingSpeed, durationMetrics object with exactly the 32 scalar ProbabilityMetric<UnitDuration> members, durationMetricArrays with exactly deleteToDeletes/longWordTouchDownUp/longWordTouchDownDown/longWordTouchUpDown, distanceMetrics with exactly the 8 scalar error-distance members, distanceMetricArrays with exactly longWordUpErrorDistance/longWordDownErrorDistance, pathErrorDistanceRatio, sentiments object with exactly the 10 SentimentCategory cases.

fields.name: timestamp
fields.meaning: Event instant from the fetch record.

fields.name: mediaIdentifier

fields.name: eventType

fields.name: timestamp

fields.name: duration
fields.meaning: Duration the report spans (SRMessagesUsageReport.duration).

fields.name: totalIncomingMessages
fields.meaning: Messages received in the interval.

fields.name: totalOutgoingMessages
fields.meaning: Messages sent in the interval.

fields.name: totalUniqueContacts
fields.meaning: Distinct contacts messaged in the interval; a count only, no identities.

jsonSchema.structure: UTF-8; one JSON array of speech-metrics records in source order; every declared field present; absent values encode as null; timestamps are seconds since the Unix epoch; CMTimeRange encodes as {"start": number s, "duration": number s}.

fields.name: timestamp
fields.meaning: Fetch-record delivery instant (SRFetchResult.timestamp); always present on every supported OS.

fields.name: speechTimestamp
fields.meaning: When the speech occurs (SRSpeechMetrics.timestamp); null on records from OS versions before its introduction.

fields.name: sessionIdentifier
fields.meaning: Audio session identifier; null before its introduction.

fields.name: sessionFlags
fields.meaning: Active SessionFlags option names; closed domain currently exactly ["bypassVoiceProcessing"]; null before its introduction.

fields.name: timeSinceAudioStart
fields.meaning: Seconds since the audio stream start.

fields.name: audioLevel
fields.meaning: {timeRange: {start s, duration s}, loudness: number (decibels, no Apple-defined reference level)}.

fields.name: speechExpression
fields.meaning: {timeRange, version: string, confidence, mood, valence, activation, dominance: dimensionless model scores}.

fields.name: speechRecognitionMetadata
fields.meaning: {speakingRate: number (words per minute), averagePauseDuration: number s, speechStartTimestamp: number s, speechDuration: number s, voiceAnalytics: {voicing, pitch, jitter, shimmer: each {frameDuration: number s, values: [number]}}|null} — the content-free projection of SFSpeechRecognitionResult.speechRecognitionMetadata.

fields.name: soundClassification
fields.meaning: {timeRange, classifications: [{identifier: string, confidence: number}]} — model labels, not audio.

nativeR4Mappings.r4Element: Observation.focus.identifier on an identifier-only logical Reference(Location)
nativeR4Mappings.cardinality: 0..1; present exactly when source locationId is present
nativeR4Mappings.identifierSystemRule: deployment- or exact source-store-scoped absolute URI; no Grove identifier-role coding
nativeR4Mappings.rule: Preserve the exact native locationId under a deployment- or source-store-scoped absolute Identifier.system. Set Reference.type to Location, omit Reference.reference, and do not assign a Grove graph-identity role. The identifier is source context for recurrence analysis, never an entry key or retraction address.

structured.rule: The widest arrival-start through departure-end Period is the effective interval; exact arrival and departure uncertainty windows remain separate Period components. This output does not assert a clinical Encounter. When SensorKit supplies locationId, preserve it exactly as Observation.focus on an identifier-only logical Location Reference under the deployment's source-store-scoped namespace; no content-empty Location resource is created.

structured.reason: A sleep-interval wrist skin reading is neither body nor basal body temperature, so version 0.6.0 publishes a platform-scoped summary rather than binding it to a shared clinical meaning.

extensionMappings.nativeR4Gap: The source supplies only an opaque algorithm-version string, not a method code or complete method concept. Observation.method.text = '1' is not self-describing, and Coding.version means the version of a code system rather than an arbitrary source algorithm version.
extensionMappings.rule: Preserve the exact non-blank source string in valueString. Do not normalize it, invent a method code, or reinterpret it as Coding.version.

recordingDeviceIdentity.stableUnitToken: A caller-governed, deployment-scoped stable token for the physical acquisition unit.
recordingDeviceIdentity.fallback: Omit Observation.device when no stable per-unit token exists; descriptive fields cannot establish instance identity.
recordingDeviceIdentity.snapshot: When emitted, the Device carries both recording-device and event-scoped device-snapshot v2 identifiers.
